---
title: "Runner Spotlight"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

This spotlight highlights standout athletes from our dataset of 2,000 Ohio high school cross country runners: the top 3 fastest runners and the top 3 who showed the most improvement from freshman to senior year, for both men and women (12 athletes total).

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# Read runner dataset
runners <- read_csv("hs_5k_2000_runners.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Standardize name display from "Last, First" to "First Last"
clean_name <- \(x) {
  ifelse(grepl(",", x), {
    parts <- strsplit(x, ",\\s*")
    sapply(parts, \(p) paste(p[2], p[1]))
  }, x)
}

runners <- runners |>
  mutate(name = clean_name(name))

# Helper to format seconds into minutes and seconds
format_imp <- \(sec) {
  mins <- floor(sec / 60)
  remainder <- round(sec %% 60)
  sprintf("%d min %02d sec", mins, remainder)
}
```

## Men

### Fastest Men

These runners clocked the fastest senior-season 5K times among all male athletes.

```{r}
runners |>
  filter(gender == "Men") |>
  arrange(senior_seconds) |>
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  transmute(
    Rank = row_number(),
    Runner = name,
    School = school,
    `Senior 5K Time` = senior_5k_time,
    `Freshman 5K Time` = freshman_5k_time
  ) |>
  kable()
```

### Most Improved Men

These runners achieved the largest time drop between freshman and senior year.

```{r}
runners |>
  filter(gender == "Men") |>
  arrange(desc(improvement_seconds)) |>
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  transmute(
    Rank = row_number(),
    Runner = name,
    School = school,
    `Time Dropped` = format_imp(improvement_seconds),
    `Freshman 5K` = freshman_5k_time,
    `Senior 5K` = senior_5k_time
  ) |>
  kable()
```

---
